comment: The system catalog: descriptive, fuel-encoding names -> family + full build config. Seeded from the NECB systems.json hvac_types descriptions; NECB reference-HP variants included (reference_hp rows). The name IS the fuel specification. | Since the HVAC taxonomy (docs/plans/HVAC_TAXONOMY_PLAN.md): `id` is the stable, model-safe key builders write into models; `legacy_name` is the name this row had before, kept as provenance and accepted as input; `aliases` holds the retired generated canonical name. Composite `parts` reference rows by `id`.
alias_config_comment: A RETIRED name builds what it built before (D-113): resolving one of these keys returns its row WITH this config merged. The eight NECB System 4 '-necbs4' rows were their System 3 row plus sys_abbr sys_4.
